title: Chronological Trust Ladder - Trust Encoding
summary: Lower numbers mean higher trust in canonical tier. Canonical paths use display year = actual calendar year minus 1000 (1026 for 2026) so verified content sorts before staging (real calendar year band).
key_principles: Canonical band in paths: 1000-1999 display year (subtract 1000 from actual year)
Staging band: 2000-2099 uses actual calendar year
Do not rewrite 1026 as 2026 in canonical memory_key for new verified exports
Verified truth outranks newness in sort order
